label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group interventional device feasibility study, and the record describes one experimental chronic speech BCI with the subject serving as their own control. There is no inactive, sham, or placebo comparator described anywhere in the design or arms, so placebo use is not supported by the record.

evidence.quote: The subject serves as their own control

title: Evaluation of the Feasibility and Efficacy of a Chronic Brain-computer Interface for Speech Rehabilitation in Patients With Locked-in-syndrome (LIS)

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
